title: ProviderManifest
description: Manifest for a provider plugin (providers/<type>/<id>/provider.json). The runtime uses it to validate node params and check secrets; the canvas uses it to build the palette and the node inspector form.

id.description: Provider id used in agent configs. Must match the plugin's folder name.

type.description: Node type this plugin implements. Must match the parent folder name.

env.description: Environment variables the provider needs, usually API keys. The compiler refuses to build a node while any are missing.

params.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the node's params. Top-level property defaults are applied before the adapter runs.
